old_problem: MPIO itself, the interfaces/services owned by mode3/index0, tuple semantics and socket coverage are undefined; no exact CE/no-reset or functional-dependency oracle exists.
disposition_reason: The source is coherent but MPIO must not be expanded from a familiar acronym, and AMD smupsp mode3/index semantics are core vendor data. Without ownership mapping, the safety blast radius and PASS checks are unknown. ED-03/15/16 prohibit inference or injection. Pending/BLOCKED remains without a source conflict.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row85, exact AI/history2484, MP5 neighbor and MPIO UCE sibling row86.
Preserved full tuple, CE/no-reset, threshold/debug and multi-OS scope.
Required an independent recovery path not carried by the tested MPIO interface.
Required exactly one source-specific CE plus link/counter/transaction/service continuity.
No acronym expansion, setting change, injection, reset, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: MPIO correctable error and owned-interface continuity
test_case.purpose: For each approved MPIO target, inject one authoritative CE, prove exactly one fresh MPIO-specific event with no reset/UCE, and preserve every owned interface and dependent service.
required_package: Vendor definition of MPIO and interface/service ownership
Independent OOB, isolated interface transaction and service-recovery limits
test_case.test_command: Do not execute the tuple. After vendor mapping, baseline all owned links/counters/services and raw controls, run one approved CE once, correlate exactly one MPIO event with no reset/UCE, perform only approved non-destructive transactions, then restore and compare every dependency.
test_case.expected_result: Exactly one fresh MPIO CE occurs at the intended target; no UCE/reset or persistent error appears; owned links, counters, isolated transactions and dependent services remain within approved limits; settings equal baseline.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until MPIO ownership and tuple semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, generic firmware text, wrong index, multiple/no events, reset/UCE, management loss, link/service anomaly or incomplete restoration fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated SUT with OOB independent of all tested interfaces.
One mapped CE and non-destructive transaction only.
Abort on reset, UCE, wrong source, management loss, link/counter or service anomaly.
expected_evidence: Vendor MPIO ownership and tuple contract
Exactly one fresh MPIO CE with zero UCE delta
test_case.recovery: Restore threshold/debug/BIOS/HDT and all MPIO-owned paths; cover unexpected reset/UCE or interface/service loss through independent OOB. Execution remains blocked until ownership and recovery are approved.
